description:
Unleash Your Adrenaline

Superior Adjustability for Personalized Performance

Superior Peak offers versatile performance, with different geometry combinations and kinematic options that allow the bike to be tuned for either stability or playfulness. You'll be ready for anything from chunky lines to massive air.

Made to Huck

Engineered for the most extreme conditions, Superior Peak features a robust aluminum alloy frame designed to endure the rigors of gravity riding. Minimal pedal kickback ensures the bike stays responsive and stable across any terrain.

Designed for the Best

Superior Peak wins. Wins at Proving Grounds, overall series win at the Big Mountain Downhill, Dark Fest Best Trick, and ridden by Kyle Strait at Red Bull Rampage.

Thoughtfully Engineered, Down to the Last Bolt

Featuring a Boost 148 rear dropout, 200mm post mount, and compatibility with air or coil shocks, the Superior Peak is built to handle the rigors of all-day bike park laps or high speed race runs. Its ISCG-05 tabs and rubber protectors help fend off rocks and keep chain noise quiet.
